synthesis.trait: Engages in meticulous, methodical personal grooming/routine in the moments before a major, consequential act
Proactively initiates contact with law enforcement himself regarding the Holly Roberts investigation
Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
Remains calm, composed, and physically non-resistant when directly confronted or threatened
Insists his actions toward Holly were morally/divinely sanctioned and denies wrongdoing when accused
Expresses simple, childlike, grounding desires (going home, playing guitar) under pressure

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
turning_points.what_changes: The same prayer ritual now continues as armed FBI agents visibly approach the building, elevating the devotional act from a private, safe routine to one performed under imminent physical danger.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
turning_points.what_changes: The unbroken prayer sequence continues without gap as agents now flank the actual door with guns raised, directly extending the prior beat's escalation.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
turning_points.what_changes: The same prayer continues uninterrupted as the battering ram is raised, the sequence's immediate next moment of rising physical threat.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
turning_points.what_changes: The prayer's final word lands in the same breath as the door splintering and agents storming in -- the same continuous ritual persisting through the literal breach.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
turning_points.what_changes: He completes the final word of the prayer while being physically slammed to the floor and handcuffed -- the ritual now continuing through direct bodily violence, the sequence's highest physical cost yet.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Practices devout religious ritual -- builds a shrine incorporating sacred imagery and Holly's portrait, recites memorized prayers
turning_points.what_changes: He repeats 'Amen' three times while restrained on the floor, the direct unbroken extension of the same ritual-under-arrest sequence to its close.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Insists his actions toward Holly were morally/divinely sanctioned and denies wrongdoing when accused
turning_points.what_changes: He states 'I gave Holly back to Trudy. Everything was OK,' verbally naming the same act of symbolic return implied by the shrine's earlier arrangement of Holly's portrait beneath the religious paintings.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Remains calm, composed, and physically non-resistant when directly confronted or threatened
turning_points.what_changes: Unlike his silent, non-resisting composure during physical arrest, sustained verbal/psychological mockery and threats of prison finally crack his containment, producing his first open emotional outburst ('Stop it!') -- exposing a limit physical force never reached.

turning_points.trait_it_relates_to: Remains calm, composed, and physically non-resistant when directly confronted or threatened
turning_points.what_changes: The crack from 'Stop it!' fully gives way here: he cries, wails, pushes away the doctor trying to help him, and thrashes his head against the table until bleeding -- the same breakdown sequence completing into total collapse.
